# Support

Ways to get help with `@inandu-solutions/grid-vue`:

- **Questions and usage help** — [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-vue/discussions)
- **Bug reports and feature requests** — [open an issue](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-vue/issues/new/choose)
- **Live demo and examples** — <https://inandusolutions.github.io/inandu-grid-vue/>
- **Angular version** — [`inandu-grid`](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid) and its
  [user manual](https://inandusolutions.github.io/inandu-grid/manual.html)
- **Security reports** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please don't open a public issue

For commercial support and the `@inandu-solutions/grid-pro-vue` add-ons, see <https://www.inandu.com>.
